country_event = {
	id = zin_dark.71
	title = zin_dark.71.t
	desc = zin_dark.71.d
	picture = GFX_zin_evt_generic_war
	is_triggered_only = yes
	timeout_days = 30
	option = {
		name = zin_dark.71.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 30
				var:global.zin_dark_moot_attacker = { is_neighbor_of = ROOT }
			}
		}
		var:global.zin_dark_moot_victim = {
			var:global.zin_dark_moot_attacker = {
				ROOT = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = PREV.PREV enemy = PREV hostility_reason = asked_to_join } }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zin_dark.71.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
			modifier = {
				add = -30
				var:global.zin_dark_moot_attacker = { is_neighbor_of = ROOT }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_dark_moot_refusals = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_dark_moot_refusals > 1.99 } }
			zin_dark_leave_free_moot = yes
		}
	}
}
